title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics, parity fixes, version bump to v1.74.0
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: There has been drift across our Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs in how auth, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics are exposed. This PR unifies the surface area, fixes parity bugs in streaming callbacks and backpressure handling, and bumps SDK versions to v1.74.0. Summary of changes: 1) Auth: centralize token refresh behavior behind a shared retryable auth hook; expose explicit on_token_refresh callback in each SDK for observability. 2) Retries: standardize transient error classification and default backoff (exponential with jitter, max attempts=5), ensure idempotency keys are preserved for retryable calls. 3) Streaming: harmonize streaming iterator and callback semantics across languages; add a cancel() method on ongoing streams (py: StreamingResponse.cancel(), ts: stream.cancel(), go: stream.Close()). Fixes for TS streaming where error frames were delivered twice under reconnect. 4) Ergonomics: simplify client construction patterns (single call client = RedwoodClient.from_env/with_config), better typed options in TS, context-managed clients in Python. 5) Parity fixes: align request parameter names (max_tokens -> max_output_tokens), unify error codes mapping, and ensure consistent header names for telemetry. 6) Version bumps: python v1.74.0, typescript v1.74.0, go v1.74.0. Migration notes: - Minimal API changes; aliases kept for deprecated names for one release cycle. - Consumers relying on old streaming callback order should update to the new contract; see examples below. Testing: unit tests added across SDKs + interop integration tests exercising streaming reconnects and retry edge cases. CI: flaky TS streaming test initially failed and was rerun successfully. Related: ENG-1423 (SDK parity effort), PM-98 (release coordination).

release_notes: Bumped SDKs to v1.74.0. Unified auth/retry behavior across Python/TS/Go, harmonized streaming ergonomics and added stream cancel() APIs, renamed max_tokens -> max_output_tokens with backward-compatible aliases, and fixed several streaming parity bugs. See docs/sdk-migration-v1.74.0.md for migration steps.
